data.body: Consideration (from S2 completion-verifier): When implementing arbiter cycle-count logic, add reader behavior for cycle-ledger.json: (a) load ARTIFACTS_DIR/cycle-ledger.json if present, (b) if reconstruction_gaps=true, log a warning to stderr and treat ledger-absent cycles as 'unknown' rather than assuming cycle 0, (c) use this cycle count for BLOCK-gate and CoVe soft-cap logic. The write side (S2) sets reconstruction_gaps correctly — S3 must implement the corresponding reader path.
